exam_scheme.note: The Fellowship Programme in Management (FPM / Ph.D. in Management) is the full-time doctoral programme offered by the Indian Institutes of Management (IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, IIM Calcutta, IIM Lucknow, IIM Kozhikode, IIM Indore, and other IIMs). Selection is a multi-stage academic process: Stage 1 requires candidates to submit valid standard test scores from recognized national tests including CAT, GMAT, GRE, GATE, or UGC/CSIR-JRF. Shortlisted candidates are evaluated on their academic record, Statement of Purpose (SOP), and research proposal. Stage 2 consists of in-depth personal interviews conducted by faculty area committees (Economics, Finance & Accounting, Marketing, Organizational Behaviour & Human Resources, Operations Management, Strategy). All admitted full-time doctoral scholars receive a 100% tuition waiver, comprehensive monthly fellowship stipends (ranging from ₹35,000 to ₹45,000 per month), subsidized campus accommodation, annual contingency grants (₹25,000 to ₹30,000 per year), and international conference presentation grants up to ₹2.5 Lakhs.
